blocks.tr:
Bu bölümde **yeni hiçbir şey yok**: 1-5. dersleri tek bir konuşmada ve beş kısa tabloda topluyorsun: *είμαι*, iki fiil grubu, *εσύ / εσείς*, *μου / σου / σας*, *σε / από*.

Anahtar nokta: kime konuştuğuna karar ver. Arkadaşına **εσύ** (*σου*, *μένεις*, *μιλάς*), tanımadığın birine **εσείς** (*σας*, *μένετε*, *μιλάτε*).
blocks.en:
There is **nothing new** in this chapter: it pulls lessons 1-5 together in one conversation and five short tables: *είμαι*, the two verb groups, *εσύ / εσείς*, *μου / σου / σας*, *σε / από*.

The key point: decide who you are talking to. A friend is **εσύ** (*σου*, *μένεις*, *μιλάς*); a stranger is **εσείς** (*σας*, *μένετε*, *μιλάτε*).

title.en: The first day at the course

blocks.tr: Önce dinle, sonra oku. Mehmet önce kursun sekreteriyle resmî, sonra Eleni ile samimi konuşuyor.
blocks.en: Listen first, then read. Mehmet talks formally to the course secretary, then informally to Eleni.

setting.tr: Kurs ofisi. Mehmet kayıt için geliyor.
setting.en: The course office. Mehmet comes to register.

lines.el: Καλημέρα σας.
lines.en: Good morning.

lines.el: Καλημέρα σας! Πώς σας λένε;
lines.en: Good morning! What is your name?

lines.el: Με λένε Μεχμέτ Γιλμάζ.
lines.en: My name is Mehmet Yılmaz.

lines.el: Χαίρω πολύ, κύριε Γιλμάζ. Από πού είστε;
lines.en: Nice to meet you, Mr Yılmaz. Where are you from?

lines.el: Είμαι από την Τουρκία, από τη Σμύρνη. Εσείς;
lines.en: I am from Turkey, from Izmir. And you?

lines.el: Εγώ είμαι από τη Θεσσαλονίκη. Πού μένετε;
lines.en: I am from Thessaloniki. Where do you live?

lines.el: Μένω στην Καλλιθέα. Είμαι μηχανικός και δουλεύω στο νοσοκομείο.
lines.en: I live in Kallithea. I am an engineer and I work at the hospital.

lines.el: Ωραία! Και το τηλέφωνό σας, παρακαλώ;
lines.en: Good! And your phone number, please?

lines.el: Το κινητό μου είναι έξι, εννιά, εφτά, διακόσια δώδεκα, σαράντα πέντε, εξήντα οχτώ.
lines.tr: Cep telefonum altı, dokuz, yedi, iki yüz on iki, kırk beş, altmış sekiz.
lines.en: My mobile is six, nine, seven, two hundred and twelve, forty-five, sixty-eight.

lines.el: Ευχαριστώ. Ελένη, από δω ο Μεχμέτ Γιλμάζ. Η Ελένη είναι φοιτήτρια.
lines.tr: Teşekkürler. Eleni, bu Mehmet Yılmaz. Eleni üniversite öğrencisi.
lines.en: Thank you. Eleni, this is Mehmet Yılmaz. Eleni is a university student.

lines.el: Γεια σου, Μεχμέτ! Χαίρω πολύ.
lines.en: Hi, Mehmet! Nice to meet you.

lines.el: Χαίρω πολύ, Ελένη. Πού μένεις;
lines.tr: Ben de memnun oldum Eleni. Sen nerede oturuyorsun?
lines.en: Nice to meet you, Eleni. Where do you live?

lines.el: Μένω στο Μαρούσι. Μιλάς ελληνικά πολύ καλά!
lines.tr: Marusi'de oturuyorum. Çok iyi Yunanca konuşuyorsun!
lines.en: I live in Marousi. You speak Greek very well!

lines.el: Ευχαριστώ! Μιλάω τουρκικά, ελληνικά και λίγο αγγλικά.
lines.tr: Teşekkürler! Türkçe, Yunanca ve biraz İngilizce konuşuyorum.
lines.en: Thank you! I speak Turkish, Greek and a little English.

lines.el: Η οικογένειά σου είναι στην Τουρκία;
lines.en: Is your family in Turkey?

lines.el: Ναι. Η μητέρα μου και ο πατέρας μου μένουν στη Σμύρνη. Και η οικογένειά σου;
lines.tr: Evet. Annemle babam İzmir'de oturuyor. Ya senin ailen?
lines.en: Yes. My mother and my father live in Izmir. And your family?

lines.el: Η οικογένειά μου είναι στην Πάτρα. Ο πατέρας μου είναι δάσκαλος.
lines.en: My family is in Patras. My father is a teacher.

lines.el: Ωραία! Το μάθημα είναι τη Δευτέρα;
lines.en: Good! Is the lesson on Monday?

lines.el: Ναι, τη Δευτέρα και την Πέμπτη. Γεια σου!
lines.tr: Evet, pazartesi ve perşembe. Hoşça kal!
lines.en: Yes, on Monday and Thursday. Bye!

lines.el: Γεια σου, Ελένη! Ευχαριστώ, κυρία Ανδρέου. Γεια σας!
lines.tr: Hoşça kal Eleni! Teşekkür ederim Andreou Hanım. İyi günler!
lines.en: Bye, Eleni! Thank you, Mrs Andreou. Goodbye!

blocks.tr: *είμαι* Ders 1'de üç biçimle, Ders 2'de altı biçimle geldi. Zamiri genelde söylemezsin: *Είμαι μηχανικός.*
blocks.en: *είμαι* came with three forms in Lesson 1 and all six in Lesson 2. You usually leave the pronoun out: *Είμαι μηχανικός.*

items.en: Mr Yılmaz, are you an engineer?

title.en: Verbs: -ω and -άω side by side (Lessons 3 and 5)

blocks.tr: Ders 3'ün **A fiillerinde** (*μένω, δουλεύω, γράφω*) vurgu hep kökte, aynı hecede kalır. Ders 5'in **B1 fiillerinde** (*μιλάω, ρωτάω, αγαπάω*) vurgu **sondaki ekte** durur. Son sütun Ders 5'in kısa biçimleri: onları tanı, ama kendin ortadakileri kullan.
blocks.en: In the **A verbs** of Lesson 3 (*μένω, δουλεύω, γράφω*) the stress stays on the same syllable of the stem. In the **B1 verbs** of Lesson 5 (*μιλάω, ρωτάω, αγαπάω*) it sits **on the ending**. The last column has Lesson 5's short forms: recognise them, but use the middle column yourself.

caption.tr: Şimdiki zaman: A fiili ve B1 fiili
caption.en: Present tense: an A verb and a B1 verb

note.tr: Olumsuz için iki grupta da fiilin önüne δεν gelir (Ders 3). Soru için ek kelime gerekmez: ses yükselir ve sona ; konur.
note.en: For a negative, δεν goes before the verb in both groups (Lesson 3). A question needs no extra word: the voice rises, and it ends in ;.

items.en: Do you work at the hospital?

items.el: Ο αδελφός μου ξυπνάει νωρίς και δουλεύει στον Πειραιά.
items.tr: Erkek kardeşim erken uyanıyor ve Pire'de çalışıyor.
items.en: My brother wakes up early and works in Piraeus.

blocks.tr: Arkadaşına, çocuğa, yaşıtına **εσύ**; tanımadığın birine, yaşça büyük birine ya da birkaç kişiye **εσείς**. Fiil ve *σου / σας* birlikte değişir.
blocks.en: To a friend, a child or someone your age: **εσύ**. To a stranger, an older person or several people: **εσείς**. The verb and *σου / σας* change together.

blocks.tr: Ders 4: "benim, senin …" isimden **sonra** gelir, isim artikelini korur. Sondan üçüncü hecede vurgulu isim ikinci bir vurgu alır: *το όνομά μου*, *η οικογένειά σου*. Diğerleri değişmez: *η δουλειά μου*.
blocks.en: Lesson 4: "my, your …" comes **after** the noun, and the noun keeps its article. A noun stressed on the third syllable from the end takes a second accent: *το όνομά μου*, *η οικογένειά σου*. The others do not change: *η δουλειά μου*.

items.el: Η μητέρα μου μένει στην Πάτρα.

blocks.tr:
Ders 3: **σε** ve **από** kelimelerinden sonra değişen çoğunlukla artikeldir; eril isim yalnızca son -ς'yi düşürür (*ο Πειραιάς → στον Πειραιά*). **σε** artikelle birleşir (*στον, στην, στο*), **από** birleşmez.

**-ν kuralı:** **τον / στον** hep -ν alır. **την / στην** onu yalnızca ünlüden ve κ, π, τ, ξ, ψ, μπ, ντ, γκ, τσ, τζ'den önce tutar. Günlerde de böyle: *τη Δευτέρα*, *την Πέμπτη*.
blocks.en:
Lesson 3: after **σε** and **από** it is mostly the article that changes; a masculine noun only drops its final -ς (*ο Πειραιάς → στον Πειραιά*). **σε** merges with the article (*στον, στην, στο*); **από** does not.

**The final -ν:** **τον / στον** always keep it. **την / στην** keep it only before a vowel and before κ, π, τ, ξ, ψ, μπ, ντ, γκ, τσ, τζ. Days work the same way: *τη Δευτέρα*, *την Πέμπτη*.

items.el: Ο Νίκος είναι από τη Θεσσαλονίκη.

blocks.tr: Yeni kelime yok: 1-5. derslerden tekrar etmeye değer kelimeler.
blocks.en: No new words: these are words from lessons 1-5 worth revising.

blocks.tr: **Artikeli unutma.** *Μένω σε Αθήνα* değil, *Μένω στην Αθήνα*. -ν'ye de dikkat: *στην Αθήνα* ama *στη Σμύρνη*.
blocks.en: **Do not drop the article.** Not *Μένω σε Αθήνα* but *Μένω στην Αθήνα*. Watch the -ν too: *στην Αθήνα* but *στη Σμύρνη*.

blocks.tr: **B1 fiiline A sonu ekleme.** *μιλάς*, *μιλάει* doğru; *μιλάεις* yanlış. Ve ikinci vurguyu unutma: *το όνομά μου*, *το όνομα μου* değil.
blocks.en: **Do not give a B1 verb the A endings.** *μιλάς* and *μιλάει* are right; *μιλάεις* is wrong. And do not forget the second accent: *το όνομά μου*, not *το όνομα μου*.

blocks.tr: A2 konuşma sınavının ilk kısmı seninle ilgili. Sınavda sana *εσείς* ile sorarlar: *Πώς σας λένε; Πού μένετε; Τι δουλειά κάνετε; Από πού είστε;* Her birine bu bölümün cümleleriyle iki üç cümle hazırla; ailen için de.
blocks.en: The first part of the A2 speaking exam is about you, and the examiners use *εσείς*: *Πώς σας λένε; Πού μένετε; Τι δουλειά κάνετε; Από πού είστε;* Prepare two or three sentences for each from this chapter, and some about your family.

blocks.tr: Şimdi sen dene: *είμαι*, fiiller, artikel ve sahiplik zamirleri bir arada.
blocks.en: Now you try: *είμαι*, verbs, the article and the possessives together.
